title: Ephesians Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on Ephesians 4: one body and one Spirit, the gifts given to the assembly, and putting on the new man.

questions.text: How does the writer describe himself as he begs them to walk worthily of their calling?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:1 opens with "I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called".

answers.text: The prisoner in the Lord
A teacher of the Gentiles
A soldier of Christ
A steward of the mysteries

questions.text: What are they told to be eager to keep?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 tells them to be eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

answers.text: The traditions handed down to them
The feasts and the new moons
The unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace
The commandments written on stone

questions.text: Which three things does verse 5 name as "one"?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says "one Lord, one faith, one baptism".

answers.text: One law, one temple, one priesthood
One Lord, one faith, one baptism
One covenant, one altar, one sacrifice
One throne, one crown, one kingdom

questions.text: Which roles does the text say he gave?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says he gave some to be apostles, some prophets, some evangelists, and some shepherds and teachers.

answers.text: Priests, scribes, judges and keepers of the temple
Overseers, servants, widows and those who show mercy
Apostles, kings, singers and watchmen of the city
Apostles, prophets, evangelists, and shepherds and teachers

questions.text: What does the text say they should no longer be, tossed back and forth by every wind of doctrine?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says this is so that they may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine.

answers.text: Children
Strangers
Slaves
Enemies

questions.text: How is the new man they are to put on described?
questions.explanation: Verse 24 says they are to put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.

answers.text: Born of the law and of the prophets, in zeal and strict obedience
Created in the likeness of God, in righteousness and holiness of truth
Made of the dust of the earth, in weakness and in need of mercy
Formed in the image of the angels, in wisdom and secret knowledge

questions.text: What are they told not to let the sun go down on?
questions.explanation: Verse 26 says "Be angry, and don't sin" and tells them not to let the sun go down on their wrath.

answers.text: Their work
Their prayer
Their debt
Their wrath

questions.text: What should the one who stole do instead of stealing?
questions.explanation: Verse 28 says he should labor, producing with his hands something that is good, so that he may have something to give to him who has need.

answers.text: Keep silent about it and say nothing to anyone in the assembly
Repay twice what he took to the one from whom he stole it
Labor with his hands at something good, so he has something to give to the one in need
Leave the city and live apart from the people he has wronged

questions.text: What kind of speech should come out of their mouth, according to verse 29?
questions.explanation: Verse 29 says no corrupt speech should proceed out of their mouth, but only what is good for building others up, that it may give grace to those who hear.

answers.text: Only what is good for building others up
Only words taught by the prophets
Only what has been written down
Only quiet speech, never loud

questions.text: Whose forgiveness is given as the pattern for forgiving each other?
questions.explanation: Verse 32 tells them to be kind, tender hearted and forgiving of each other, just as God also in Christ forgave them.

answers.text: The elders of the assembly
The apostles who taught them
Their own fathers and mothers
God, who in Christ forgave them
